body: 2026-09-24. A child process cannot change the parent shell's directory, so `new` / `resume` are two-phase: run with AGX_PLAN_FILE set, the binary writes a plan JSON (dir, profile, resume id; never secrets; mode 0600; `version` must be 1), the generated shell function cds, emits OSC 7, then runs hidden `agx exec --plan` which deletes the plan and execs (syscall.Exec in internal/cli/exec_unix.go; Windows runs a child in exec_other.go). Why: all logic stays in tested Go; the shell layer (internal/shellinit, zsh + bash) is ~20 generated lines.
title: AGX-003: plan-file shell protocol for new/resume
